semantics.receiverBinding: Any legal named receiver binds its actor instance; self is conventional, not a mandatory alias. Renaming all bound body references preserves dispatch ABI and state write footprint.
semantics.alphaEquivalence: Foo mut self.state.{counter,xyz} and Foo mut this.state.{counter,xyz} have equal typed write-set identity; receiver naming alone cannot overload a method.
semantics.receiverScope: The guard binder must be distinct from receiver name; receiver name cannot collide with formals or be shadowed; mistaken self references are unbound after renaming.
semantics.nestedArgumentGate: Member-call argument expressions are recursively inspected at source preflight: send(receiver.state.x) cannot hide a direct state access.
semantics.mutationGate: Critical state writes detect direct, prefix ++/--, and split compound assignments. Nested/indexed fields and unknown field calls fail closed pending typed effect proofs.
semantics.artifactGate: Rust native attoc negative compilation must produce the expected diagnostic with nonzero exit and no .wasm output; compiled actor guest parity is still NOT_EXECUTED.
